units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 14:7">Num. R. s. 14</cite> (play on <he>אל תבהל מפניו</he>, <cite ref="Ecclesiastes 8:3">Koh. VIII, 3</cite>) <he>לא נתבהל מפ׳ הבית</he> he (Joseph) was not bewildered by the emptiness of the house (his being alone with Potiphar’s wife).

<cite ref="Mishnah Avodah Zarah 5:6">Ab. Zar. V, 6</cite> <he>לפי שאין פ׳ לנסך</he> because the invaders do not take time to offer a libation (so as to make the wine forbidden, v. <cite ref="N00946"><he>נָסַךְ</he></cite>).

<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 71a:1">Ib. 71ᵃ</cite> <he>לנסך אין פ׳ לבעול יש פ׳</he> for libation they do not take time, but for outrage they do. Y. ib. V, 45ᵃ top <he>אין פ׳ להטיל אירס</he> the snake (being pursued) finds no opportunity to shed venom; a. fr.
